en.hook: Why AI Analytics Still Depends On Strong Data Engineering
en.body: Text-to-SQL, retrieval, and AI copilots only become valuable when they sit on top of governed pipelines, trusted metadata, and well-structured delivery paths.
en.cta: Read the full story on the site and use GitHub as the operational proof point.
